en.headline: 16 commits across two repos plus a bug report on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-08, `sogeisetsu` logged **16 commits** across two repositories, with no pull requests, reviews, or releases. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 14 own commits plus 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` reshaped the flow documentation: the two flow diagrams were fully redrawn to encode "no infinite loop" as visual language with four gates, the push-flow diagram was redrawn to include the Cloudflare Workers Builds line, a new diagram was added showing what happens after pushing one commit to `main`, the flow diagrams were switched to the Excalifont handwriting font (fontFamily 5 -> 1), an ops index was added pointing to the two diagrams and the watchdog, and the watchdog docs gained a Workers Builds auto-deploy note with watch-paths pitfalls plus a new Excalidraw runtime-chain diagram. A watchdog feature change extended the fallback scope to a second workflow (the 30-day activity card) so the two timelines are computed independently. In `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, 2 commits split the run-flow sketch into en/zh scenes, wired the README figures, and added a bilingual hand-drawn Excalidraw sketch of the run flow.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共 16 次提交，并在 openchamber 提交了一个 bug 报告
zh.summary: 2026-10-08 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库共完成 **16 次提交**，没有 PR、评审或发布。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，14 次本人提交，另有 15 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，主要围绕流程文档重构：两张流程图被完全重画，把「不会无限循环」做成图形语言并加上四道闸门；推送流程图重画以纳入 Cloudflare Workers Builds 那条线；新增一张「往 `main` 推一次提交之后会发生什么」的图；流程图字体换成 Excalifont 手写体（fontFamily 5 -> 1）；新增 ops 索引指向两张图与 watchdog；watchdog 文档补上 Workers Builds 自动部署配置与 watch paths 踩坑记录，并新增一张 Excalidraw 运行链路图。watchdog 功能上，兜底范围扩到第二个 workflow（30 天活动卡片），两条时间线各算各的。在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 中，2 次提交把 run-flow 草图拆成 en/zh 场景、接入 README 图片，并新增一张双语手绘 Excalidraw 运行流程草图。Issue 方面，`sogeisetsu` 在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开 issue `#4537`，标题为「[Bug] OpenCode Go quota shows "Provider not configured" while the Providers page shows an API key for it」，随后追加了两条评论；`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复一次，将该报告标记为 `fix-ready`，并确认两个界面在当前 `main` 上解析 OpenCode Go 凭据的方式不一致。
